title: The Crooked Salt
author: Wendell Zhou
blurb: Emrys Fairweather, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
